Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Outlines the module's learning topics across browser animation fundamentals, CSS transitions, CSS keyframe animations, and JavaScript-driven animation, serving as a navigational overview for learners and instructors to see what concepts will be covered and in what order.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: A topic outline covering browser animation fundamentals, including how animations work, their impact on user experience, and an introduction to CSS-based versus JavaScript-driven animation approaches; used by learners to preview module content and by instructors to plan lesson structure.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to Browser Animation
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how browser animation works under the hood, why it matters for user experience, and introduces the two main animation approaches (CSS and JavaScript), used by learners to build foundational knowledge before exploring specific techniques.

Artifacts.Name: CSS Transitions
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains CSS transitions — how they smoothly animate property changes between two states without JavaScript, including syntax, timing functions, and practical use cases — used by learners to implement simple, state-driven animations.

Artifacts.Name: CSS Keyframe Animations
Artifacts.Description: A reading that covers CSS keyframe animations, explaining how to define multi-step animations using @keyframes and the animation property, including looping, reversing, and controlling intermediate states, used by learners to create complex, self-running CSS animations.

Artifacts.Name: JavaScript-Driven Animation with requestAnimationFrame
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains the requestAnimationFrame API, how it synchronizes JavaScript animations with the browser's rendering engine for smooth, performant motion, and how to structure an animation loop, used by learners to build custom JavaScript-driven animations.

Artifacts.Name: Animation Performance and Best Practices
Artifacts.Description: A reading that covers browser rendering performance for animations, including the 60 fps target, the impact of different CSS properties on the rendering pipeline, and best practices for keeping animations smooth, used by learners to optimize their animation implementations.

Artifacts.Name: Animation Performance and Best Practices
Artifacts.Description: A duplicate reading identical to artifact 6 that covers browser rendering performance for animations, the 60 fps threshold, and best practices for smooth animation, used by learners to review or reinforce animation performance concepts.
